pull.title: KAFKA-15853: Move KRAFT configs out of KafkaConfig
pull.body:
- Move all Kraft configs/docs/defaults into `KRaftConfigs`. 
- Note: We have already `RaftConfig` but it seems to contain limited amount of configs that only configure `controller` raft and shouldn't include configs shared by both broker/controller in KRAFT mode or only for broker in KRAFT mode.  
    - `RaftConfig.QUORUM_VOTERS_CONFIG` is the only exception to this rule and I am not sure if it should be defined in `KRaftConfigs` and shared by `RaftConfig` or if it should be `RaftConfig`. Originally this config had an alias in KafkaConfig but most places where it referred to `KafkaConfig.QuorumVotersProp` has access to `RaftConfig.QUORUM_VOTERS_CONFIG`. 
    - I choice to use  `RaftConfig.QUORUM_VOTERS_CONFIG` everywhere as the prefix for defining this config is defined in `RaftConfig` if people prefer that we move this to `KRaftConfigs` (this might be tricky and we may need to move `KRaftConfigs` int `server-common` instead) or revert this [commit](https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/15775/commits/6974959a1baf8e61cff372de2b2ba90774ebc34d) and keep the original approach from `KafkaConfig` please let me know. 

### Committer Checklist (excluded from commit message)
- [ ] Verify design and implementation 
- [ ] Verify test coverage and CI build status
- [ ] Verify documentation (including upgrade notes)
